notes:
Summary: Large national healthcare contact center. Primary problem: long handle times for payment/insurance questions + need strict PCI/PHI controls. Looking to automate agent assist + ticket summarization to reduce AHT and surface required compliance prompts.

Recent timeline and activity:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (AE: Maya). They described 4 contact centers, ~1.2k agents, ~3k concurrent chats at peak. Fireflies: ff_20260218_7432.
- 2026-02-24: Security intake submitted (SaaS questionnaire). Sent initial answers + asked about VPC private control plane.
- 2026-02-28: Deep dive with Infra + Sec (SE: Luis) — discussed network model, KMS, no egress for PCI token flows. Fireflies: ff_20260228_8110.
- 2026-03-01: Demo of hosted infra tradeoffs; client wants Private deployment for POC.
- 2026-03-04: Provided POC scope doc + sample contract language. Drive links above.

POC requirements / technical notes:
- POC: 6 weeks in customer VPC (us-east) with Private control plane.
- Workloads: agent-assist (real-time suggestions 150-400ms p95), ticket summarization (batch nightly for 500k tickets/mo), tool-calls (update ticket status, redact PCI tokens).
- Scale: expect burst spikes up to 7k concurrent requests during payment cycle windows; need autoscale/burst plan and predictable tail latency.
- Model preferences: open/Redwood-verified LLM variants with quantization options; ability to pin versions and failover to smaller/model-lite during spikes.
- Data handling: strict PHI/PCI rules — redact tokens locally, zero-copy storage for raw PCI fields, 7+ years retention for audit (legal asks), exportable audit logs, immutable retention windows.
- Security: SSO via SAML, enterprise KMS integration (customer-managed keys), long-term audit logging to SIEM, periodic pen tests and SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence required.
- Tooling: must support tool-calling whitelist, scoped credentials for external ticketing system (ServiceNow / Genesys connectors), and function-calling with allowlist and request-level attestations.

Customer quotes / voice:
- "We can't have any PCI tokens leaving our VPC — redaction has to be enforced at the edge." (Head of Contact Ops)
- "Agent suggestions must be reliable during day-of-month payment peaks — fallback behavior is critical." (VP Support Ops)

Open questions / risks:
- Can Redwood provide SIEM-forwarding for audit logs with agreed retention and format?
- Clarify egress model for third-party embedding stores (they want no external embedding services).
- Legal wants precise SLA for tail latency during autoscale events.

Next steps (short):
- 1) Run infra/security workshop (SE + Sec) to map VPC topology and KMS integration.
- 2) Delivery & infra to propose POC AMI/manifest and timeline.
- 3) Legal to exchange redlined contract (client will push PCI scoping language).
- 4) Technical kickoff once SAML + VPN completed (target 2026-03-15).

POC success metrics (customer):
- Reduce average handle time (AHT) by 18-25% for payment flows.
- p95 agent-assist latency < 400ms during normal load, <700ms at 95th percentile for spikes.
- 99.99% audit log delivery to SIEM during POC.

Misc: They maintain a large legacy ticket backlog (500k tickets). Interested in batch summarization to seed knowledge base; eventual plan to route high-risk payment tickets to human-only path.

Stenography: convo notes are shorthand in Drive; see drive:/Clearway/notes/ for meeting artifacts.
